title: SUMMARIZE keeps a group whose added expression is BLANK

source.quote: One row is returned for each group.
source.supports: a row per group, with no rule that removes blank results

source.quote: Only rows for which at least one of the supplied expressions return a non-blank value are included in the table returned.
source.supports: removing blank rows is documented for SUMMARIZECOLUMNS, not for SUMMARIZE

derivation: Groups of Product by Color: Red, Blue, Green. Sales Amount: Red 460 (rows 1, 2, 3, 5, 7: 100 + 40 + 20 + 200 + 100), Blue 80 (rows 4, 6: 50 + 30), Green BLANK (no sales). SUMMARIZE returns one row per group, so Green stays with a BLANK.
notes: No source says in so many words that SUMMARIZE keeps the row; it follows from one row per group and from the blank-row removal being a SUMMARIZECOLUMNS feature. Compare aggregation/sum-by-color, where SUMMARIZECOLUMNS drops Green.
